final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT f.orderslink, o.ordertune, AVG(f.rebtotal) AS avg_rebate, AVG((f.rebrate - f.feerate) * 1.0 / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS avg_rate_ratio FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.ordertune), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rebate) AS avg_rebate FROM grouped) SELECT g.orderslink, g.ordertune, g.avg_rebate, g.avg_rate_ratio, g.avg_rebate - a.avg_rebate AS difference FROM grouped AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS a WHERE a.avg_rebate IS NOT NULL AND g.avg_rebate > a.avg_rebate ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
